note: Rules of scripts/vfx/vfx_plan.py. vfx_signals are Python regexes matched case-insensitively against the request text with URLs removed; a request with none of them (and no --effect) is NOT_VFX. effect_id_patterns name the effect id inside the request text (group id, a kebab-case recipe id); --effect wins. Authoring paths come from the registry first (module ids under registry, the contract's source path for gen-runs) and fall back to the defaults here. The vfx-style module (authoring.vfx-style) is registered; its default is the place the vfx-style schema names. Step states: DONE, IN_PROGRESS, TODO, NEEDS_APPROVAL, STALE, FAIL, BLOCKED (meanings in states). lead_domain resolves a step's lead skill through registry domains.<d>.lead; lead_skill is the fallback when the domain is not registered.

states.DONE: the step's output exists, is bound to the current inputs and (where a person approves it) has an approval record for its current revision
states.IN_PROGRESS: the step's output exists but is not finished (an open lifecycle state, or a later part of the step is missing)
states.TODO: the step's output does not exist yet
states.NEEDS_APPROVAL: the output is finished but has no approval record for its current revision (only a person approves)
states.STALE: the output is bound to another revision of its input (a capture of an older recipe, an approval of an older revision, a hash that does not match the asset)
states.FAIL: the step's own check failed (lint FAIL rows)
states.BLOCKED: the output is blocked, rejected, deprecated or superseded

steps.title: Style profile present and approved
steps.action: author the project's vfx-style profile from templates/vfx/vfx-style.md under the authoring vfx style path, check it with scripts/vfx/vfx_style.py show, then ask a person to approve it (binding_values: an approval record is required)

steps.title: Texture gen-runs approved
steps.action: generate the effect textures with rpg-factory:asset-gen (a vfx purpose and the profile's assetgen_style), have a person approve each gen-run, and cite each AGEN-<run id> in the sources of the effect's vfx-spec

steps.title: Recipe and built asset
steps.action: write <Name>.vfxrecipe.json (cuvara.vfx-recipe/1, id = the effect id) in the effect folder and build it with com.cuvara.vfx Tools~/vfxcli.py build, which writes <Name>.vfx next to it

steps.title: Capture and lint
steps.action: capture the built effect with Tools~/vfxcli.py capture at the profile's camera, lighting and seed, then run scripts/vfx/vfx_style.py lint --style <profile> --recipe <recipe> --inspect <inspect> --stats <stats.json> and save its JSON next to stats.json as vfx-lint.json; a person reviews the contact sheet (HUMAN_REQUIRED)

steps.title: vfx-asset delivery record
steps.action: write the vfx-asset record from templates/vfx/vfx-asset.md: asset_path of the built effect, its content hash, the capture stats, the checks run (vfx-lint), sources citing the vfx-spec and the gen-runs; then take it through review
